ref.locator: DOC 56 1281/002, programme 31.2 'Federale culturele instellingen', p. 22; division 34 'Belgisch Centrum voor Cyberveiligheid', programme 34.1, p. 41; division 36 'Zetelbeleid', p. 44-45
ref.quote: Het gaat om de Koninklijke Muntschouwburg (KMS), het Nationaal Orkest van België (NOB) en het Paleis voor Schone Kunsten (PSK).
ref.note: The 'Zetelbeleid' (host-country policy) division includes the pension scheme of former NATO staff who stayed in Belgium and host-nation support such as SHAPE force protection; part of it follows from international agreements. The CCB's tasks are set by royal decree and the NIS2 law of 26 April 2024. The line also includes the Chancellery's own staff, the Federal Institute for Sustainable Development and union premiums (vakbondspremies) for the federal administration. confirmed
